canonicalWording: Same imperial council as EVT-0001, narrated before the Marshal's decision.
reconstructionBasis: D-40 is a placement: the council must precede Gadora's audience, which follows two "several days" passages on the Tempest side (v12.txt:11582, 11817).

canonicalWording: Evening of the imperial council day (v12.txt:12870-12876).
reconstructionBasis: Same day as the imperial council (EVT-0001); 21:00 is a placement.

canonicalWording: The next day the army left the Empire.
reconstructionBasis: Departure the day after the imperial council (CANONICAL_RELATIVE). The march from the capital to the border base (D-39 to D-34) and the slow advance from D-32 are interpolations.

canonicalWording: "Several more days" after the previous Tempest scene; "no movement today either".
reconstructionBasis: D-34 is a placement after two "several days" passages (v12.txt:11582, 11817). Same day as Gadora's return (EVT-0025), which interrupts the scene.

canonicalWording: "The first step" once the imperial moves were known; same period as the war council.
reconstructionBasis: Placed on R0 (D-33), one hour before the war council, which meets in the same room.

canonicalWording: Already done when "a month has passed" (V13 Ch1).
reconstructionBasis: The crossing is undated; it is only stated as already done at the month mark (D-3). D-5 is a placement inside the interpolated march (MOV-018). No location effect is set, so the column follows transit.json.

canonicalWording: A month has passed since the subordinates' gathering met.
reconstructionBasis: "A month" is taken as thirty days after R0 (D-33). R0 itself is a placement.

canonicalWording: "Soon after that, the days we had waited finally ended."
reconstructionBasis: "Soon after" the month mark; D-2 is a placement. The halt position is not stated and is drawn at the forest edge, where transit.json ends.

canonicalWording: Reported by Soei on the day of the Gazel call; the camp itself is undated.
reconstructionBasis: The camp must exist before Soei's report on D+0; D-1 18:00 is a placement that gives the march into the forest about a day and a half.

canonicalWording: Shown on the Control Room screens just before the final Gazel call.
reconstructionBasis: The arrival time on this plain is not stated; D+0 08:00 is when the array is first shown and may be later than the arrival. End event for MOV-001.

canonicalWording: a full day after the raid began, about 350,000 had entered
reconstructionBasis: Day 1 of the operation = D+1 is a placement: the corps was advancing on the capital during the surface battle (v13.txt:6690-6691) and no interval is stated. 08:00 is a simulation time.

canonicalWording: the next morning; ten thousand destroyed in less than an hour
reconstructionBasis: Canon dates the sally as 'the next morning' after the first day of the operation: 'on the first day they explored almost all of floors 60-69 ... on the first day the gate was still closed ... the next morning' (v13.txt:9907-9937). R5 canon resolution places it on D+2; 07:00 is a simulation time.

canonicalWording: day three of the operation
reconstructionBasis: Day canonical relative to day one; 08:00 is a simulation time.

canonicalWording: not all floors explored until the third day was nearly over
reconstructionBasis: The fight spans days 1-3 of the operation; it is placed at its stated end, late on day three (D+3 21:00, simulation time).

canonicalWording: the raiders from the upper floors joined them on the fourth day
reconstructionBasis: Day four is canonical relative to the operation's start; 09:00 is a simulation time.

canonicalWording: seven days after the Labyrinth Raider operation began
reconstructionBasis: D+8 = day one (D+1) + seven days. 09:00 is a simulation time.

canonicalWording: the next day (after Minitz's night on floor 78)
reconstructionBasis: Minitz enters 'the next day' after the night he rested (v13.txt:11907-11917), so D+10 if the dispatch is D+9. 13:00 is a simulation time allowing the floor-79 fight and the three-hour wait.

canonicalWording: after dawn broke; Krishna had been sent in two days earlier
reconstructionBasis: Day canonical relative to the elite dispatch (two days earlier); 07:00 is a simulation time after dawn.

canonicalWording: the spell ran all day; V14 Ch1 opens the day after the resurrection
reconstructionBasis: One day after the annihilation is a placement (the gathering of remains needs time); V14 Ch1 is 'the day after the resurrection' (v14.txt:875). 10:00 is a simulation time for a spell that ran all day.

canonicalWording: the day after the resurrection of nearly 700,000
reconstructionBasis: The day is one after the resurrection (D+12, itself a reconstruction); the hour is a placement.

canonicalWording: three days after the revival
reconstructionBasis: Day canonical relative to the revival; the hour is a placement.

canonicalWording: the banquet had to wait for the next day
reconstructionBasis: Day canonical relative to the rewards day; the evening hour is a placement.

canonicalWording: the day after drinking with Elmesia; the meeting ends at dusk
reconstructionBasis: Day canonical relative to the Elmesia night (itself a reconstructed D+17); the hour is a placement.
Day D+19 and the 18:00 time are simulation placements (AUDIT-PLAN skeleton row 23): the novel gives no clock time for the return or the party.

canonicalWording: the next day
reconstructionBasis: Day is canonical relative to the party ('the next day'); 09:00 is a simulation placement.

canonicalWording: ten in the morning
reconstructionBasis: Day D+23 follows the AUDIT-PLAN skeleton: party on D+19, officers' day off D+20, interviews to D+22, summit 'the next day' (v16.txt:4880, 7510). Clock time is a simulation placement inside the session the text names. The opening at ten is stated (v16.txt:8365).

canonicalWording: the next morning
reconstructionBasis: Day is canonical relative to the summit ('the next morning'); 08:00 is a simulation placement.

Day RECONSTRUCTED (AUDIT-PLAN skeleton row 27): 'done within a week, departure soon after' from the summit (v16.txt:9773); 08:00 is a placement. Testarossa's embassy posting is undated; it is placed here because she reports from the Empire by then (v16.txt:9775-9777).
